native.scope: Actual native title/Home, seeded current-engine cage contact, stationary visible player/unchanged steps, turn-away and cleared-cage entry, one rescued ID after normal OS close/reopen, inherited pace/sliders/mute and preference restoration
limits: Discrete-input single-cage smoke, not all-side/held-input/mid-effect close or full solver/migration/follower/reward qualification; require separate PLAY-B evidence.
No actual effective-gain or acoustic audibility claim from these UI assertions; use separate AUDIO-01V graph/listening evidence.
Inherited regression smoke only: no camera-performance fix, compact-layout acceptance, native sustained-timing, physical-iPad efficacy, installer, signing, offline or clean-machine qualification.
Title Exit is not used by this inherited smoke; PHONE1 manifest separately requires actual native Exit evidence.

nativeTitleExit.reviewer: Root Astra — actual Computer Use operator and final review
nativeTitleExit.method: Actual root Computer Use navigation and trusted pointer/keyboard Title Exit events; synthetic-profile-only QA input buffer written synchronously at capture and read after saved-profile reopen; actual process identity/exits independently read from Windows. Root observed focus, activated actual controls and checked returned window inventory/process termination. Cold completed subcheck from exit-r2, saved keyboard/reopen from exit-r4; no all-attempts-pass claim.

reuse.priorOverallAttemptStatus: Failed later at saved-keyboard console delivery; only its already-completed cold pointer subcheck is reused, not the full cohort.
reuse.rootAuthorization: Root explicitly selected this exact PID/source/portable-bound cold subcheck instead of repeating cold launch after console delivery races.

savedTitleExit.windowClosureBasis: The previously observed owning native process no longer exists after a trusted real Title Exit activation; root must also inspect actual window disappearance.
savedTitleExit.method: Root Computer Use Tab traversal and Enter on focused native Title Exit

limitations: Cold pointer qualification reuses only completed exit-r2 cold PID 23560/window 7936866 for this exact source and portable. The prior overall saved-observer failure remains failed and preserved; this attempt makes no fresh cold-run claim.

QA-only localStorage input evidence is written by the observational capture listener in new synthetic profiles; application save/preferences keys are not changed by this observer. Console delivery is supplementary for saved keyboard Exit, not its acceptance authority.
Raw observation only: root must review actual Computer Use/window evidence before the release-review envelope is marked pass.
The final ordinary OS cleanup is not the inherited stationary-rescue close/reopen regression; link that fresh separate native summary.
Visible-tile order/content may be canonically recomputed on mount; core run identity/game, hints, durable progress and preferences are asserted semantically, not byte-for-byte localStorage equality.
Synthetic existing raw 12/64 and Zippy preferences only; no acoustic, AUDIO-01V2 calibration, compact layout, signing, installer, physical-device or sustained-performance claim.
No close/destroy/window.close/browser.close API, synthetic click, scripted keypress, force-kill or CDP browser-close surrogate is used.

compactUI.reviewer: Astra — independent source, visual and final-browser review
limitations: Normal-text synthetic safe areas and browser geometry are not physical-phone/iPad comfort or all-screen accessibility acceptance.
Exact primary comparator was captured at Exit-base033f8748 with unchanged v0.22.4 primary geometry; not a new physical or v0.22.4 baseline capture.
Compact More-menu and small board at568 remain disclosed tradeoffs; Home/dialog/victory/full200percent text/HUD pace art are later scope.

retainedLimitations: Physical iPad scrolling remains unresolved. No camera-performance change or promotion hint ships.
Bounded compact gameplay/Book and native Exit only; Home/dialog/victory/200 percent text/HUD pace/settings art and broader UI remain.
Fresh art validator required unchanged ignored historical v14 proofs restored externally; 136 art tests inherited from byte-unchanged inputs, not rerun. 429 historical warnings.
Failed art/source-status and native observer attempts preserved. Native Exit cold completed subcheck from exit-r2; keyboard/reopen exit-r4; not a clean first-attempt claim.
Same rules/content/save schema as v0.22.4; no additional restart. Older pre-v0.22.4 unfinished-run migration still applies.
Unsigned x64 portable only. No installer, signing, clean-machine, offline, sustained-native, physical-family or acoustic acceptance.
AUDIO-01V2 calibrated 75/75 defaults not in this build. Existing chosen gains unchanged.
Raw screenshots/traces and synthetic profiles remain external; Git backs up compact hashed release records, not private profiles.
